description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the AbstractServiceBase class in the Eclipse Hono project. It verifies port configuration, TLS settings, and initialization behavior for the service base class.

classes.name: AbstractServiceBaseTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AbstractServiceBase, testing port selection, TLS configuration, and startup behavior.

methods.name: initMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock objects for Vertx and EventBus before each test.

methods.name: createService
methods.description: Creates an anonymous subclass instance of AbstractServiceBase with specific configurations for testing.

methods.name: checkSecurePortAutoSelect
methods.description: Test that the secure port is selected automatically when only key store path is configured.

methods.name: checkSecurePortExplicitlySet
methods.description: Test that the explicitly set secure port is used when configured.

methods.name: checkNoPortsSet
methods.description: Test that service startup fails if no port or key store is configured.

methods.name: checkInsecureOnlyPort
methods.description: Test that insecure port is used when only insecure port is enabled.

methods.name: checkInsecureOnlyPortExplicitlySet
methods.description: Test that a specifically set insecure port is used.

methods.name: checkBothPortsOpen
methods.description: Test that both secure and insecure ports are enabled when configured.

methods.name: checkBothPortsSetToSame
methods.description: Test that configuration fails when insecure and secure ports are set to the same value.

methods.name: testAddTlsKeyCertOptionsDisablesAllProtocolVersionsButTls12
methods.description: Verify that only TLSv1.2 is enabled by default after adding TLS options.

methods.name: testAddTlsKeyCertOptionsDisablesTlsProtocolVersions
methods.description: Verify that only specified TLS protocols are enabled based on configuration.
